text: oh one thing about the current traffic lights you will need to address. they place like this: [Image #5] so the light part of it just needs a rotate 90 degree so it can be correct on it
resolution: Fixed in commit bcafd0015 (already pushed before this entry was logged): the traffic light's mast arm and lamp head both pointed the same way (-Z), leaving the head a quarter turn off a real signal. The arm now cantilevers sideways (+X) over the road with the head hanging at its end, lamps still facing -Z at yaw 0 — which is exactly the facing world/traffic.ts uses to decide which approach the signal governs, so the lamp now LOOKS at the lane it gates. Fixed in both the live model (hmsc/render3d/props/TrafficLight.tsx) and the compiled geometry (hmsc-int/compile/worldGeometry.ts); hot reload shows it in the editor, the compiled game needs a re-compile.
